EVACUATIONS ORDERED AS NORTE FIRE TEARS THROUGH SAN CLEMENTE

Evacuation orders are now in effect as the Norte Fire spreads near Portico Del Norte.

The fire started around 11:30 a.m. and has burned at least 250 acres, pushed by Santa Ana winds and 90-degree heat. OCFA says homes and other structures are in the fire’s path. Crews are hitting it hard from the air and on the ground.
